data.title: Repeated words
data.statement:
When proofreading, some people have a hard time seeing repeats, especially if they're broken up onto different lines. The brain just ignores them.

Output all repeated words, one on each line, in the order they're found. If there's capitalization differences, use the the first word of the two.

If there are no repeats, just write "No repeats!"
